I’m glad that everything has been resolved with Annalie. 
Hopefully everything goes without a problem and we will be able to leave this place for good.
I don’t know shit about fashion, but I’m sure Annalie will make an impact. 
Let’s hope the impact won’t be too big, I wouldn’t want {f_botName}’s secret to be exposed…
It’s risky, but I owe this much to Annalie.
